data.body: PASS-1 (E4) review note for the backfill story: the Scope directs writing a peer-confirmation record with `confirmed_pass=pass_id`, `confirmed_at=<now ns>` and a signature `backfill_from_managed_refs(store, local_tickets, binding_store, pass_id)`. The current `PeerConfirmationStore.record()` (peer_confirmations.py:144) has NO `confirmed_pass`/`confirmed_at` parameters — those per-pass fields were deliberately dropped (bug 266c / epic 0303 churn discipline, see docstring at ~line 167) because they had no production reader and rewrote the whole sidecar every pass. The record instead carries only `first_confirmed_at`. The plan's field/parameter list should be reconciled with the current `record()` contract.
